edit.report:
All changes were made in "Haim Michael" only. I didn't open or change any other composition.

Settings applied:
- **Studio Sound:** on, intensity 80%.
- **Limiter:** there is no dedicated limiter control, so I used the compressor as one. Threshold −1 dB, ratio 20:1, attack 0 s, release 0.1 s, knee 0 dB.
- **Volume:** gain 3 (300%).
- **Filler words:** I muted all 175 detected filler words (uh, um, well, you know, kind of, and repeated words like "the, the"). A final search finds none left. They are muted, not deleted, so they can be restored.
- **Word gaps:** gaps longer than 2 seconds were shortened to 1 second (10 gaps). The script went from 1211 s to 1196 s.

Two side effects:
- **Wrong words muted, then restored:** my first filler pass muted some non-filler words in the second half, because timings shifted after the earlier cuts. I restored all of them, then re-ran the filler removal on fresh timings.
- **Track unmuted:** the tool also reported unmuting the track while applying volume. I don't know whether it was muted before.
